modules.title: Introduction to Ngwaa (Verbs)
modules.html:
Igbo verb roots, tenses and aspects. This section covers introduction to ngwaa (verbs).

Key points

  • Mgbakwunye (Affix) na-abịa n'ihu ngwaa bụ _____. — Mbuụzọ.
  • Ahịrịokwu a 'Obi tiri mkpu' nwere ụdị ngwaa wo — Ngwaa mbufe.
  • Mgbakwunye na-abịa n'ihu ngwaa bụ _____. — Mbuụzọ.
  • Kpọọ ngwaa dị n'ahịrịokwu a: 'Nne siri nri'. — Siri.
  • Ihe na-abịa n'ihu ngwaa iji mepụta ajụjụ bụ _____. — Mbuụzọ 'ọ̀' ma ọ bụ 'ì'.

Worked examples

Q: Mgbakwunye (Affix) na-abịa n'ihu ngwaa bụ _____.
A: Mbuụzọ — A prefix (mbuụzọ) is an affix added to the beginning of a verb root.

Q: Ahịrịokwu a 'Obi tiri mkpu' nwere ụdị ngwaa wo?
A: Ngwaa mbufe — 'Tiri' is a transitive verb (Ngwaa mbufe) because the action passes to the object 'mkpu'.

examples.q: Ahịrịokwu a 'Obi tiri mkpu' nwere ụdị ngwaa wo?

quiz.q: Mgbakwunye (Affix) na-abịa n'ihu ngwaa bụ _____.
quiz.solution: A prefix (mbuụzọ) is an affix added to the beginning of a verb root.

quiz.q: Ahịrịokwu a 'Obi tiri mkpu' nwere ụdị ngwaa wo?
quiz.solution: 'Tiri' is a transitive verb (Ngwaa mbufe) because the action passes to the object 'mkpu'.

quiz.q: Mgbakwunye na-abịa n'ihu ngwaa bụ _____.
quiz.solution: A prefix is called 'Mbuụzọ' because it comes at the beginning (ihu) of a word root.

quiz.q: Kpọọ ngwaa dị n'ahịrịokwu a: 'Nne siri nri'.
quiz.solution: 'Siri' (cooked) is the verb or action word.

quiz.q: Ihe na-abịa n'ihu ngwaa iji mepụta ajụjụ bụ _____.
quiz.solution: Prefixes like 'ọ̀' (e.g., ọ̀ riri?) are used to create questions.

quiz.q: Olee n'ime ndị a bụ ngwaa (verb)?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Gaba.

quiz.q: Kedu ụdị ngwaa bụ 'gaa'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Ngwaa iwu.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Mbem'?
options: Abụ na-atọ ụtọ nke nwere udaolu pụrụ iche
quiz.solution: Mbem is oral poetry or chants often performed by minstrels or elders at events.

quiz.q: Kedu mkpụrụasụsụ a kpọrọ 'mgbochiume imi' (Nasalized consonants)?
quiz.solution: These sounds are produced through the nasal cavity (imi).

quiz.q: Ịmụta asụsụ Igbo dị mkpa maka _____.
options: Inwe nghọta banyere omenala na njirimara ndị Igbo
quiz.solution: Learning the language is vital for cultural identity and preservation of Igbo heritage.

quiz.q: Olee nke bụ 'mgbochiume kpachịrị akpachị' (Digraph)?
quiz.solution: 'gb' consists of two characters representing one sound, which is a digraph.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Metaphor' n'asụsụ Igbo?
quiz.solution: Mburu is a direct comparison (metaphor) in Igbo literature.

quiz.q: Olee ememme a na-eme tupu e rie ji ọhụrụ?
quiz.solution: New Yam Festival (Ịwa ji/Iri ji) is done to thank the gods for a successful harvest.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Noun'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Nkeaha.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Money'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Ego.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'House'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Ụlọ.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Book'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Akwụkwọ.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Eye'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Anya.

quiz.q: Kedu ihe 'Oji' nọchitere anya ya n'ala Igbo?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Omenala na Nnabata.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Akụkọ'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Story.

quiz.q: Kedu ihe 'Chukwu' pụtara?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: God Almighty.

quiz.q: Kedu nke bụ 'Isi'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Head.

quiz.q: Wane gari ne cibiyar kasuwanci a Arewa?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Kano.

quiz.q: Wane abinci ne aka fi sani da Hausawa?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Tuwo da Miya.

quiz.q: Fassara: 'Good morning'.
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Ina kwana.

quiz.q: Wanne ne 'Kasuwanci'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Business/Trading.

quiz.q: Gịnị ka a na-akpọ 'God' n'asụsụ Igbo?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Chukwu/Chineke.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Friend' n'Igbo?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Enyi.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Ten' n'asụsụ Igbo?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Iri.

quiz.q: Kedu mmanwụ a maara ama na-apụta n'oge ikpe ikpe n'ala Igbo?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Ajonkwu.

quiz.q: Ọ bụrụ na mmadụ asị gị 'Ị rụala', ọ pụtara...
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: You have worked well.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Goat'?
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Ewu.

Gịnị ka a na-akpọ nwa mụrụ n'ụbọchị 'Afọ' — Gbogbo ha bụ eziokwu.
Gịnị bụ aha mbụ onye malitere idepụta asụsụ Igbo — F.C. Ogbalu.
quiz.solution: Gịnị bụ 'House' — Ụlọ.
